description:
Complete a news inscription — STEP 2, the reveal, after the commit has confirmed.

Pass the SAME title, body and parentInscriptionId used at commit: the reveal script is derived from all three. The commit's actual output is checked against the script this content derives, so a mismatch is refused before signing rather than losing the sats.

Returns the inscription id and link for legion_propose_story.

No mainnet confirmation is asked for here, unlike the commit: those sats are already committed, and refusing the reveal would strand them rather than save them.

Requires an unlocked managed wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

body.description: Same body used in the commit step

commitTxid.description: Txid of the confirmed commit transaction

feeRate.description: Fee rate for the reveal tx (default: medium)

parentInscriptionId.description: Same parentInscriptionId used in the commit step, if any

title.description: Same title used in the commit step

name: legion_inscribe_reveal
